name: D&D 5.5e Combat Engine
description: Tabletop d20 combat engine for D&D 5.5e. Resolves ability-score modifiers (CHA/INT/WIS/STR/DEX), AC, spell attack rolls, saving throw DCs, cantrip scaling, martial extra attacks, rogue sneak attack, and HP. Add as an Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents for Roleplay and Game modes.
author: custom-mods
defaultPromptTemplate:
Resolve the current turn of D&D 5.5e combat from the latest narrative and combat state.
Set encounterActive true whenever active combat actions are occurring; set false when combat has resolved or is inactive.

RULES & MATH FORMULAS:
1. Ability Modifiers: floor((AttributeScore - 10) / 2). E.g. 20 -> +5, 18 -> +4, 16 -> +3, 14 -> +2, 10 -> +0, 8 -> -1.
2. Proficiency Bonus by Level: Lvl 1-4: +2, Lvl 5-8: +3, Lvl 9-12: +4, Lvl 13-16: +5, Lvl 17-20: +6.
3. Class Primary Stat Mapping for Spellcasting & Attacks:
   - Warlock / Sorcerer / Bard / Paladin -> Charisma (CHA)
   - Wizard / Artificer -> Intelligence (INT)
   - Cleric / Druid / Ranger -> Wisdom (WIS)
   - Rogue / Monk / Archer -> Dexterity (DEX)
   - Fighter / Barbarian -> Strength (STR) or Dexterity (DEX)
4. Spell Attack Roll: 1d20 + Casting Ability Modifier + Proficiency Bonus vs Target AC.
5. Spell Save DC: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Casting Ability Modifier vs Target Saving Throw (1d20 + Target Save Mod).
6. Cantrip Scaling (Dice count / Beams):
   - Lvl 1-4: 1 die (e.g. 1d10 Fire Bolt, 1 beam Eldritch Blast: 1d10 + CHA)
   - Lvl 5-10: 2 dice / 2 beams (e.g. 2d10 Fire Bolt, 2 separate Eldritch Blast beams at 1d10 + CHA each)
   - Lvl 11-16: 3 dice / 3 beams (e.g. 3d10 Fire Bolt, 3 beams Eldritch Blast)
   - Lvl 17-20: 4 dice / 4 beams (e.g. 4d10 Fire Bolt, 4 beams Eldritch Blast)
7. Martial Extra Attack:
   - Lvl 1-4: 1 attack
   - Lvl 5-10 (Fighter, Barbarian, Paladin, Ranger, Monk): 2 attacks per action
   - Lvl 11-19 (Fighter): 3 attacks per action; Lvl 20 (Fighter): 4 attacks per action
8. Rogue Sneak Attack:
   - When attacking with Advantage or with an ally within 5ft of target, add ceil(RogueLevel / 2)d6 damage (e.g. Lvl 1-2: +1d6, Lvl 3-4: +2d6, Lvl 5-6: +3d6).
9. Critical Hits (Natural 20): Double all damage dice rolled. Critical Miss (Natural 1): Automatic miss.
10. HP Tracking: Apply damage to Target HP. At 0 HP: Mark enemies as 'defeated'; mark player characters as 'unconscious / death saves'.

Return only valid JSON matching this schema:
{
  "encounterActive": boolean,
  "event": "none|start|turn|end",
  "roundNumber": number,
  "combatants": [
    {
      "id": "string — character ID or name",
      "name": "string",
      "side": "player|enemy",
      "level": number,
      "unitClass": "string",
      "ac": number,
      "hp": { "current": number, "max": number },
      "stats": {
        "str": number,
        "dex": number,
        "con": number,
        "int": number,
        "wis": number,
        "cha": number
      },
      "spellDc": number,
      "attackBonus": number,
      "status": "active|unconscious|dead|fled|defeated",
      "conditions": ["string"]
    }
  ],
  "resolvedAction": {
    "actorName": "string",
    "actionType": "attack|cantrip|save_cantrip|heal|dash|dodge",
    "targetName": "string",
    "d20Roll": number,
    "toHitTotal": number,
    "targetAc": number,
    "isHit": boolean,
    "isCrit": boolean,
    "damageDice": "string (e.g. 2d10+4)",
    "damageDealt": number,
    "sneakAttackApplied": boolean,
    "sneakAttackDice": "string|null",
    "multiAttacks": [
      {
        "beamIndex": number,
        "d20Roll": number,
        "toHit": number,
        "hit": boolean,
        "damage": number
      }
    ],
    "logSummary": "string — concise tactical combat log (e.g. The warlock casts Eldritch Blast [Roll 16+7=23 vs AC 14 - HIT! Deals 1d10+4 = 11 Force damage])"
  },
  "currentTurn": "string|null",
  "summary": "string"
}
If combat is inactive, return { "encounterActive": false, "event": "none", "roundNumber": 0, "combatants": [], "resolvedAction": null, "currentTurn": null, "summary": "" }
